title: Jingling Meng Yeluoli x Bing Lianhua

alternative_titles.en: The Fairy Dream of Yeloli: Ice Lotus

synopsis:
This is China's first animated series centered on figure skating. Set in a fictional magical parallel world, the story follows the Ice Princess—now an adult—and the Yeloli fairies as they bravely forge ahead in pursuit of self-realization. While overcoming challenges, they also advocate for environmental protection, encouraging audiences to pay attention to issues such as the melting of the Earth's glaciers.

(Source: Official YouTube Channel, translated)
